Captured from the real OLIMEX STMP157-OLinuXino-LIME2 rev B1 DDR subsystem,
rendered from TSX using tscircuit 0.0.3120 / Core 0.0.2302 / autorouter 0.0.1060.

Source: [OLIMEX/OLINUXINO, revision 85eee9c](https://github.com/OLIMEX/OLINUXINO/tree/85eee9c17ee13af65617d73bdd94de7ec49cfb42/HARDWARE/STMP157-OLinuXino-LIME2).
Attribution: OLIMEX Ltd. The source design and this derived routing fixture
retain [CC-BY-SA-3.0-US](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/us/).

The TSX fixture is pinned at
[core-ddr-benchmark 8ad0e1e](https://github.com/ShiboSoftwareDev/core-ddr-benchmark/tree/8ad0e1e2cc4c7069ce8d52e4a7d7e0ccc1cfb67c).
The remaining-phase SRJ SHA-256 is
`880851355b9865406272a4fa52867e210f7067bdd31965cd972f818b6772c936`.

The fixture preserves the numeric topology, route reservations, committed
assignments and current route from the second blocker search, before reripping.
It contains 140,283 regions and 250,738 ports. Typed numeric arrays are encoded
in JSON to keep the capture portable. Unused port/region debug metadata was
omitted; physical coordinates, costs and search ordering were preserved.

The SVG shows the captured input and the returned relaxed blocker path in black.
That path requires moving an existing route; it is not final PCB copper.
